subject: math
question: 设 $A=(a_{ij})$ 是 n 阶实矩阵， $\alpha_{1,2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 是 A 的 n 个列向量，且均不为零，证明 $\operatorname{rank}A\geqslant\sum_{i=1}^{n}\frac{a_{ii}^{2}}{\alpha_{i}^{\mathrm{T}}\alpha_{i}}$ .

steps.text:
分析 不等式的右边是矩阵 A 的列向量单位化后所做成矩阵主对角元素的平方和，如果 A 的列向量组是单位正交向量组，结论是显然的；否则可将 A 的列向量组用其等价的单位正交向量组来表示，再计算不等式右边的值，并与左边做比较.

注意到用非零数乘以矩阵的列向量，不会改变矩阵的秩. 这是因为

$$
\left(k _ {1} \alpha_ {1}, k _ {2} \alpha_ {2}, \dots , k _ {n} \alpha_ {n}\right) = \left(\alpha_ {1}, \alpha_ {2}, \dots , \alpha_ {n}\right) \operatorname{diag} \left(k _ {1}, k _ {2}, \dots , k _ {n}\right).
$$

当 $k_{i} \neq 0 (1 \leqslant i \leqslant n)$ 时， $\operatorname{diag}(k_{1}, k_{2}, \cdots, k_{n})$ 可逆，所以 $\operatorname{rank}(k_{1} \alpha_{1}, k_{2} \alpha_{2}, \cdots, k_{n} \alpha_{n}) = \operatorname{rank}(\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n})$ .

故不妨设 $\alpha_{1},\alpha_{2},\cdots,\alpha_{n}$ 都是单位向量，即 $\alpha_{i}^{T}\alpha_{i}=1$ 。问题变为证明 $\operatorname{rank}A\geqslant\sum_{i=1}^{n}a_{ii}^{2}$

设 $\operatorname{rank}A = k (k \leqslant n)$ ，将 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n}$ 的一个极大无关组用施密特正交化方法化为单位正交向量组 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{k}$ ，则向量组 $\alpha_{1}, \alpha_{2}, \cdots, \alpha_{n}$ 与 $\beta_{1}, \beta_{2}, \cdots, \beta_{k}$ 等价.

设 $\alpha_{i}=\sum_{j=1}^{k}x_{ij}\beta_{j}(i=1,2,\cdots,n)$ ，则 $x_{ij}=\beta_{j}^{T}\alpha_{i}$ ，即有

$$
\pmb {\alpha} _ {i} = \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\pmb {\beta} _ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \pmb {\alpha} _ {i}) \pmb {\beta} _ {j}, \text {且} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\pmb {\beta} _ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \pmb {\alpha} _ {i}) ^ {2} = \pmb {\alpha} _ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \pmb {\alpha} _ {i} = 1.
$$

记 $\boldsymbol{\varepsilon}_{i}=(0,\cdots,0,1,0\cdots,0)^{\mathrm{T}}$ （第i个分量为1，其余全为0），则

$$
a _ {i i} = \varepsilon_ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \alpha_ {i} = \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\beta_ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \alpha_ {i}) (\varepsilon_ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \beta_ {j}).
$$

利用柯西-施瓦茨不等式，有

$$
a _ {i i} ^ {2} = \left(\sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {i}) (\boldsymbol {\varepsilon} _ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j})\right) ^ {2} \leqslant \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\alpha} _ {i}) ^ {2} \cdot \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\boldsymbol {\varepsilon} _ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j}) ^ {2} = \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} (\boldsymbol {\varepsilon} _ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j}) ^ {2},
$$

所以

$$
\sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} a _ {i i} ^ {2} \leqslant \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} \left(\varepsilon_ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j}\right) ^ {2} = \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} \sum_ {i = 1} ^ {n} \left(\varepsilon_ {i} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j}\right) ^ {2} = \sum_ {j = 1} ^ {k} \left(\boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j} ^ {\mathrm{T}} \boldsymbol {\beta} _ {j}\right) = k = \operatorname{rank} A.
$$

meta.syllabus_note: 列向量单位化秩下界不等式*
meta.commentary:
评注（1）将向量用标准正交基来表示，其系数（坐标）更便于计算，两向量的内积也特别简单.

(2) 柯西-施瓦茨不等式: 设 $\alpha, \beta$ 为两 $n$ 维列向量, 则 $\left(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\beta\right)^{2} \leqslant \left(\alpha^{\mathrm{T}}\dot{\alpha}\right)\left(\beta^{\mathrm{T}}\beta\right)$ , 当且仅当 $\alpha, \beta$ 线性相关时取等号.
